将 u/v 方程采样为曲面、点云或线框；支持参数、时间和周期网格。: Sample u/v equations as surfaces, point clouds or wireframes, with parameters, time and periodic meshes.
屏幕空间宽度；与缩放和设备像素比无关。: Screen-space width, independent of zoom and device pixel ratio.
保持曲面三角网格不变，独立设置两个参数方向的线数。: Set line counts for each parameter direction without changing the surface triangles.
直接评估方程，独立于曲面三角网格分辨率；最多合计 100 万个曲线采样点。: Evaluate equations directly, independently of surface mesh resolution. At most one million curve samples in total.
固定 U、沿 V 延伸。0 隐藏；独立曲线包含参数域两端；一条线位于中间。: Hold U fixed and extend along V. Zero hides lines. Independent curves include both parameter-domain endpoints; a single line lies in the middle.
固定 V、沿 U 延伸。直接采样参数方程；网格很粗时曲线仍可保持平滑。: Hold V fixed and extend along U. Direct equation sampling keeps curves smooth even with a coarse mesh.
独立实现的 GPU 物体坐标纹理；不依赖几何采样使用 CPU 或 WebGL2。: Independent GPU object-space texture, available with either CPU or WebGL2 geometry sampling.
参数速度在边界环绕或反射；旧场景的网格闭合也沿用此开关。: Parameter motion wraps or reflects at the boundary. Legacy mesh closure also follows this switch.
可引用初始 u/v 和方程参数；留空沿用旧周期速度。启用后周期边界默认往返，流动: May reference initial u/v and equation parameters. Leave empty for legacy cycle speed. Enabled periodic boundaries default to reflection; the flow switch selects wrapping.
周期轴环绕；非周期轴平移参数域。方程可直接使用 t。: Periodic axes wrap; other axes translate the parameter domain. Equations can use t directly.
参数在边界反射；关闭时周期轴环绕，非周期轴平移。: Reflect parameters at boundaries. Otherwise periodic axes wrap and nonperiodic axes translate.
曲面使用点云模式；吸引子使用连续粒子模式。历史按指定时间重建，预览和导出一致。: Use point mode for surfaces and continuous particle mode for attractors. History is reconstructed at the requested time consistently for preview and export.
关闭后停止新增记录，已有记录按寿命自然过期；显示开关独立控制可见性。: Stop adding records while existing records expire naturally. Visibility is controlled separately.
最多100万个历史顶点；过大时明确报错，不静默丢弃粒子。: At most one million history vertices. Oversized requests report an error instead of silently dropping particles.
显式微分方程、Euler / RK4 数值积分与可复现的多粒子轨迹。: Explicit differential equations, Euler/RK4 integration and reproducible particle trajectories.
连续模式每模拟帧执行指定子步；与视频导出帧率独立。: Each simulation frame runs the specified substeps, independently of the video export frame rate.
总积分预算200万步，输出预算100万个顶点。: Two million integration steps and one million output vertices maximum.
标量场等值面；以共享边顶点的 Marching Tetrahedra 生成真实三: Scalar-field isosurfaces, triangulated with shared-edge vertices using Marching Tetrahedra.
单独设置为4–96；设0时使用默认网格分段。: Set independently to 4–96, or use 0 for the default grid subdivisions.
二维或三维离散映射；nx / ny 可显式引用本步先计算的新坐标。: Two- or three-dimensional discrete maps. nx/ny explicitly reference newly computed coordinates from the same step.
zₙ₊₁（仅 3D；可引用 nx、ny）: zₙ₊₁ (3D only; may reference nx and ny)
1保留窗口内全部密度；0仅保留当前帧；按真实点权重衰减后统一映射。: 1 retains all density within the window; 0 retains only the current frame. Actual point weights decay before unified color mapping.
达到此点数的像素映射到白点；曝光与伽马仍可调节。: Pixels reaching this count map to the white point. Exposure and gamma remain adjustable.
带复共轭项的迭代映射生成 n 重旋转对称图案。: Iterated maps with complex-conjugate terms create patterns with n-fold rotational symmetry.
种子控制的三维梯度噪声驱动流线、旋流与无散度流场。: Seeded 3D gradient noise drives streamlines, vortices and divergence-free flow.
每 N 模拟步记录拖尾: Record trails every N simulation steps
内外滚动圆组成转子链，笔尖记录精确参数曲线。: A chain of circles rolling inside or outside one another traces exact parametric curves.
非空启用顺序绘制的多层位图；图层可独立设置转子、颜色、线宽、闭合停止。: A nonempty value enables sequential multilayer raster drawing. Each layer has independent rotors, colors, line width and closure stopping.
留空使用上方单转子；例如 [{\"radius\":1,\"mode\":\"i: Leave empty for the single rotor above; for example [{"radius":1,"mode":"inside","speed":1}]
圆、椭圆和简单多边形内的镜面反射粒子，保持速度大小。: Specularly reflected particles inside circles, ellipses and simple polygons, preserving speed.
留空使用正多边形；例如 [[-3,-2],[3,-2],[0,3]]: Leave empty for a regular polygon; for example [[-3,-2],[3,-2],[0,3]]
两个实函数映射随机样本，并在平面或地图投影中展现结构。: Map random samples through two real functions into a plane or map projection.
复平面迭代与轨道着色；含 Mandelbulb 三维边界点云。: Complex-plane iteration and orbit coloring, including a 3D Mandelbulb boundary point cloud.
中心 X 低位（与高位相加）: Center X low part (added to high part)
中心 Y 低位（与高位相加）: Center Y low part (added to high part)
复变函数的相位、模与迭代等值线。: Phase, magnitude and iteration contours of a complex function.
迭代 w →（w 当前值，z 像素，c 常量）: Iteration w → (w current value, z pixel, c constant)
抽样复系数多项式，按所选数学规则求解并绘制根的分布。: Sample complex-coefficient polynomials and plot root distributions using the selected math rules.
多项式 = 0 · 可使用采样参数面板中的名称: Polynomial = 0 · Use names from the sampling parameters panel
复平面迭代与轨道着色；含 Mandelbulb 三维距离估计光线步进与体素点云。: Complex-plane iteration and orbit coloring, including 3D Mandelbulb distance-estimation ray marching and voxel point clouds.
Map/Symmetry 保留每个粒子的状态；Samila 每批生成新的确定随机: Map and Symmetry retain each particle state; Samila generates a new deterministic random batch.
每个粒子推进指定次数，只累积最后一个位置。: Advance each particle by the requested number of steps; accumulate only its final position.
保留小数输入，计算时四舍五入；0 和 1 都使用前一次迭代值。: Fractional inputs are preserved and rounded for evaluation; 0 and 1 both use the previous iterate.
完整有限采样目标；未完成时可暂停播放、取消或导出当前密度。: Complete finite sampling target. Pause playback, cancel, or export the current density before completion.
独立求解调度，不等同于原版根点队列批大小。: Independent solver schedule, distinct from the original root-point queue batch size.
只决定根点的分块提交，不改变随机样本、总数或结果。: Controls only root-point chunk submissions, without changing random samples, totals, or results.
留空的旧项目沿用根坐标缩放；独立设置后分别缩放 X/Y。: Older documents without this value use the root coordinate scale. Set it to scale X and Y independently.
GPU 求值，颜色计算共享同一色板。分支切线与数值风险点使用 CPU 修复；多步: GPU evaluation with the shared palette. Branch cuts and numerical risk points use CPU repair; multi-step iterations, precision or device limits trigger an explicit fallback.
CPU 双精度 Durand–Kerner；独立 {fps} Hz 调度，本次推: CPU double-precision Durand–Kerner; independent {fps} Hz schedule, {frames} new steps, {attempted} / {total} polynomial samples completed.
残差为归一化后向误差，不保证重根或病态多项式的根位置精度；随机序列与原版 Jav: Residual is normalized backward error; it does not guarantee root-position accuracy for repeated or ill-conditioned roots. The random sequence differs from the original Java workers.
{count} 个多项式未通过残差检查，未输出其近似根。: {count} polynomials failed residual checks; their approximate roots were not plotted.
{count} 个参数样本的多项式无效或超出双精度范围。: {count} parameter samples had invalid polynomials or exceeded double precision.
渐进复根需要 Complex Roots 场景: Progressive roots require a Complex Roots scene.
渐进复根时间须为 0–86400 秒: Progressive root time must be between 0 and 86400 seconds.
渐进复根工作缓冲超过 768 MiB；请减少画布或每步样本数: Progressive root buffers exceed 768 MiB; reduce the canvas or samples per step.
渐进复根单次请求超过 {limit} 次求解操作；总采样数未缩减，请降低每步样本: This progressive root request exceeds {limit} solver operations. The total sample target is unchanged; reduce samples per step or advance in smaller increments.
渐进复根单次请求超过 200 万个参数样本；总采样目标未缩减，请分段播放或缩短跳: This preview request exceeds 2 million parameter samples. The full target is retained; advance in smaller increments or shorten the seek.
渐进复根总数和采样时钟不能在运行中动画改变: The progressive root total and sampling clock cannot be animated during a run.
根坐标范围无法建立有限密度视口: The root coordinates cannot define a finite density viewport.
累计求根操作数超过精确整数范围: Accumulated solver operations exceed the exact integer range.
采样过滤参数不存在：{name}: Sampling filter parameter does not exist: {name}
CPU Durand–Kerner 求根；仅输出通过归一化残差检查的根。: CPU Durand–Kerner root solving; only roots passing normalized residual checks are plotted.
求根迭代次数须为1–2000: Root solver iterations must be between 1 and 2000.
求根初始相位必须有限: The initial root-solver phase must be finite.
零多项式有无限多个根: The zero polynomial has infinitely many roots.
多项式最高支持48次: Polynomials up to degree 48 are supported.
多项式系数比例超出双精度范围: Polynomial coefficient ratios exceed double precision.
求根初始半径超出双精度范围: The initial root-solver radius exceeds double precision.
求根迭代次数须为整数: Root solver iteration count must be an integer.
独立像素单位；保留 CPU 双精度求根，未等同原版世界尺寸投影。: Independent pixel units; root solving remains CPU double precision, without claiming native world-size projection parity.
根求解保留 CPU 双精度；GPU 仅作 float32 点密度累积与调色，累积: Root solving remains CPU double precision. GPU performs float32 point accumulation and tone; rounding may differ from CPU.
软圆盘使用独立像素直径；原版世界尺寸投影、平均度量调色与密度归一化尚未等同。: Soft discs use independent pixel diameters; native world-size projection, mean-metric coloring and density normalization are not reproduced.
GPU 复根累积不可用，已从头重放 CPU：{0}: GPU root accumulation unavailable; the entire request was replayed on CPU: {0}
GPU 复根累积保留，最终调色回退 CPU：{0}: GPU root accumulation retained; final tone falls back to CPU: {0}
GPU 单像素最大权重 {mass}；高重叠的 float32 RGB 累加有可: GPU maximum pixel mass is {mass}. Heavy-overlap float32 RGB accumulation can visibly round; choose CPU double-precision density to compare.
自动 · 大粒子云使用 GPU: Automatic · GPU for large particle clouds
GPU 支持最多200万个无历史粒子；Euler/RK4 在 GPU 执行。拖尾: GPU supports up to 2 million particles without history, using Euler or RK4 integration. Trails use the existing CPU path. Requests exceeding CPU fallback capacity fail explicitly without reducing the particle count.
GPU 点云最多200万；CPU最多1万且受积分和历史预算约束。: GPU clouds support up to 2 million particles. CPU supports up to 10,000, subject to integration and history budgets.
归一调色仅支持持续 Map 和 Symmetry: Normalized tone supports continuous Map and Symmetry only
归一调色参考与输出边长须为 1–16384 的整数: Normalized reference and output dimensions must be integers from 1 to 16384
归一调色需要持续批次密度: Normalized tone requires continuous batch density
归一调色需要持续累积器提供真实批次事实: Normalized tone requires actual batch facts from the continuous accumulator
归一密度尺度需要 CPU 双精度调色: This normalization scale requires CPU double-precision tone mapping
保存在项目中的物理像素宽度；导出与预览共用，不随窗口自动改变。: Physical pixel width saved in the project, shared by preview and export; it does not change automatically with the window.
保存在项目中的物理像素高度；此尺寸不代表原应用的未知窗口尺寸。: Physical pixel height saved in the project; it does not represent the unknown reference application window size.
控制归一对数密度的平滑限制曲线；与白点密度是不同参数。: Controls the smooth limiting curve for normalized log density; this differs from white-point density.
归一调色使用已记录批次和保存的参考画布尺寸；保留本地采样、色板和点形状，不保证原: Normalized tone uses recorded batches and the saved reference canvas size. Sampling, palette and splat shapes remain independent; native pixel parity is not claimed.
已另存 Map/Symmetry 的归一调色参数与源默认值；当前仍使用兼容白点模: Map/Symmetry normalized tone parameters and source defaults are retained separately. The compatible white-point model remains active. Enable normalized tone from a completed image to save a local reference size; the original application reference canvas size is unknown.
Invert 的公开声明与包内绑定不一致：Map 固定补色，Symmetry 固: The published Invert description conflicts with package bindings: Map always complements the value, and Symmetry binds invert to false. The source field is not exposed as a variable control.
settings.{0}={1}：归一模型按源运行边界使用 {2}，兼容白点模型: settings.{0}={1}: normalized tone uses {2} within source runtime limits; compatible white-point tone uses {3}. The original value remains in source.
切换到二维会清空 z 方程；切换回三维会设为 z。可撤销。: Switching to 2D clears the z equation; switching back to 3D sets it to z. You can undo this change.
GPU 完成坐标、复数、色板、等值线与超采样。风险像素按全部子像素进行 CPU: GPU computation covers coordinates, complex values, palettes, level curves and supersampling. Every subsample of a risky pixel is repaired on the CPU. Multi-step iterations, precision limits or device limits trigger an explicit fallback.
按指南公式、视口和等值线设置创建。未公开设置采用默认值，补全说明保存在来源信息中: Uses the guide’s formula, viewport and contour settings. Unspecified settings use defaults; the assumptions are retained in the source information.
按指南公式、视口和等值线设置创建。配色及其余设置取自对应安装包配置。“Newto: Uses the guide’s formula, viewport and contour settings. Colors and remaining settings come from the corresponding packaged configuration. “Newton” is the guide’s name; its formula contains +c and is not standard Newton iteration.
按指南公式、视口和等值线设置创建。配色及其余设置取自对应安装包配置。按实际配置使: Uses the guide’s formula, viewport and contour settings. Colors and remaining settings come from the corresponding packaged configuration. The configuration uses a PIXEL_Z seed; ZERO in the original file name does not change the calculation.
按指南公式、视口和等值线设置创建。配色及其余设置取自对应安装包配置。按实际配置执: Uses the guide’s formula, viewport and contour settings. Colors and remaining settings come from the corresponding packaged configuration. It evaluates sin(w + z²) as configured; the original description of a linear iteration does not change the calculation.
保留指南 R=150、r=75、笔距 75；源运动学下退化为直线，不替换为花瓣曲: Preserves guide R=150, r=75 and pen distance 75. Source kinematics gives a line; no flower is substituted.
按指南的定子 150、内转子 50 与笔距 60 绘制星形。: Uses guide stator 150, inside rotor 50 and pen distance 60.
按指南的定子 150、内转子 75、外转子 30 与笔距 40 绘制嵌套旋轮。: Uses guide stator 150, inside rotor 75, outside rotor 30 and pen distance 40.
原版先排序再转 Float32；允许相等边界，超出有限 Float32 范围会明: Endpoints are sorted before conversion to Float32. Equal endpoints are allowed; values outside the finite Float32 range produce an error.
原版数学采样不消费此字段；本地随机探索属于独立工具。: The source mathematical sampler does not use this field. Local random exploration is a separate tool.
用于可重放的本地采样，不是原版每帧 ThreadLocalRandom 随机流。: Controls repeatable local sampling, independently of the original per-frame ThreadLocalRandom stream.
